text: Hi Anna, just following up on my email from Tuesday. Do you have any updates on the budget? Thanks in advance.
Hi team, a quick status update: the design is finished, development is about halfway done, and testing starts next Monday. No blockers at the moment.
Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Thursday afternoon? I'd like to walk you through the proposal and answer any questions you may have.
Thank you for thinking of me for this project. Unfortunately, my schedule is full until the end of the quarter, so I have to decline. I'd be happy to recommend a colleague who could help.
Heads up, I'll be offline from 2 to 3 for a dentist appointment. Ping me if anything is urgent.
Please find the report attached. Let me know if you would like me to change anything before we share it with the client.

Dear Mr. Evans, thank you for your time yesterday. As discussed, I am sending a summary of the next steps. We will deliver the first draft by Friday, and we would appreciate your feedback within a week.
Good catch, thanks! I've fixed the typo and pushed the change. Can you take another look when you have a minute?
Thanks for the quick reply. I'll review the document today and send you my comments by tomorrow morning.
I'm writing to confirm our meeting on Wednesday at 10 AM. Please let me know if the time no longer suits you.
Quick question: do we have the final numbers for last month? I need them for the report that is due on Friday.
I'm out of the office until Monday. For urgent matters, please contact my colleague Mark.
Apologies for the delay. We ran into a problem with the supplier, but it has now been solved. You can expect the delivery next week.
Could you share the slides from today's presentation? I'd like to pass them on to the people who couldn't attend.

Following our conversation, I would like to formally request two weeks of leave starting on the first of August. I have already arranged cover for my projects and will make sure everything is handed over properly before I go.
Great work on the launch, everyone. The feedback from customers so far has been really positive.
I'm afraid I can't join the call at three. Could we move it to four, or should I send my notes instead?
Please find attached the invoice for October. Payment is due within 14 days. Let me know if you need anything else.

I wanted to raise a concern about the timeline. With the current scope, I don't believe we can finish by the end of the month without cutting corners. Could we discuss which features are truly necessary for the first release?
Welcome to the team! Your laptop and badge are waiting at the front desk, and I'll show you around at nine.
Morning! Does anyone know if the meeting room on the second floor is free after lunch?
Thank you for your application. We were impressed by your experience and would like to invite you for an interview next week.

As agreed, here is a short summary of the meeting. First, marketing will prepare the campaign by the tenth. Second, sales will update the price list. Third, we will meet again in two weeks to review the results. Please reply if I have missed anything.
I've finished the first version of the design. It's not perfect yet, but I'd love your honest opinion before I go any further.
